name: Legora
summary: Collaborative AI platform for lawyers covering review, research and drafting.
description: Legora is a collaborative AI platform for law firms. Lawyers use it to review documents, research and draft, and it presents an agentic operating system for legal work. The company announced a $550M Series E. Access is through a demo, and no public prices are listed. It is aimed at law firms and in-house legal teams. Security and customer pages are published on the site.
